import copy

def doc(**changes):
    value = copy.deepcopy(BASE)
    for key, item in changes.items():
        if item is _DELETE:
            del value[key]
        else:
            value[key] = item
    return value


class _Delete:
    pass


_DELETE = _Delete()


def mutate(path, value=_DELETE):
    node = copy.deepcopy(BASE)
    parts = path.split('.')
    target = node
    for part in parts[:-1]:
        target = target[int(part)] if part.isdigit() else target[part]
    last = parts[-1]
    if value is _DELETE:
        if isinstance(target, dict):
            target.pop(last, None)
        else:
            target[int(last)] = None
    else:
        if last.isdigit():
            target[int(last)] = value
        elif isinstance(target, dict):
            target[last] = value
        else:
            target.append(value)
    return node

def check():

    for name, document, want in CASES:
        try:
            if want == 'input':
                got = run(document)
                ok = got == {'error': 'input'}
                detail = repr(got)[:80]
            else:
                got = run(document)
                ok = got != {'error': 'input'}
                detail = '' if ok else repr(got)[:200]
        except Exception as exc:
            ok = want == 'input'
            detail = 'raised %r' % (exc,)
            if type(exc) not in (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, IndexError, UnicodeError, RecursionError):

            failures += 1
            print('FAIL', name, 'want', want, detail)
